name: Prapor
blurb: Weapons and ammunition dealer. The first trader most players work with.

name: Therapist
blurb: Medical supplies, food and provisions. Essential early healing items.

name: Skier
blurb: Black-market goods and barter trades. Strong roubles and gear deals.

name: Peacekeeper
blurb: Western weapons, attachments and gear, traded in US dollars.

name: Mechanic
blurb: Weapon parts, modding and ammunition crafting specialist.

name: Jaeger
blurb: Hunting and survival gear. Must be unlocked before trading.

name: Fence
blurb: Resells items bought from other players. Reputation-gated deals.

name: Ref
blurb: Arena-linked trader dealing in GP coins and special gear.

name: Lightkeeper
blurb: Endgame trader on Lighthouse, tied to high-level quest chains.

name: BTR Driver
blurb: Provides BTR transport services and a small set of tasks.
